title: base-7.0 vs base-7.1
verdict_rule: better means the new pack called the target API and the previous pack did not. worse means the previous pack called the target API and the new pack did not. Rows from a different verb do not count. On Find hoppy citrus beers the target is search hybrid. That row is worse when the previous pack calls search hybrid and the new pack calls search fts, find, or set, even when both sides are HTTP 200 and both returned beers. same means both called the target, or neither did. not run means a model call is missing. When the question says rows are required, an empty Zeus result is not met.

rows.text: What beers come from Belgian breweries?

The engine doc marks that forward terminal projection as not yet. The selective side worked: from Brewery where country=belgium, inverse Beer.brewery_id, limit 5, HTTP 200, truncated. Rows included Oude Geuze, Drie Fonteinen Kriek, and Leffe Blonde. Country where name=Belgium inverse to Brewery returned 0 rows. Evidence is not required because the textbook forward body does not return rows.

rows.target_api: search hybrid Hotel + search hybrid Landmark (rows required)
rows.notes: Scoped like beer-colorado-itinerary. The country is already in the question, so the target is one hybrid search for Hotel and one for Landmark. Rows are required. SQL++ on 2026-11-18: country = France and the whole word beach in name, city, description, or title is 0 hotels. FTS description/name/city beach in France is also 0. Coastal French hotels still exist without that word: Nice 7, Saint-Florent 2, Cannes 1, Saint-Raphaël 1, Bonifacio 1. Landmarks in France with beach in name, city, content, or activity: 2 (Dramont beach in Saint-Raphaël, and Normandy American Cemetery because the content says Omaha Beach).
